The '''mission to Sernpidal''' occurred during the [[Jedi Civil War]], when a team of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] agents were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]]. The agents planned to obtain a [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinder]] from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Doel Scherp]], which contained the command codes for the sensor systems of [[Darth Revan's flagship]]. The agents learned of Scherp's location on the world, then confronted him and obtained the code cylinder. The Republic later used the command codes contained within the cylinder during an [[Capture of Darth Revan|attempt]] to capture [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]], the leader of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].
